title: WCW vs WWF — portrait roster identity export
identity_key_policy: Keep each source ID byte-for-byte. Do not join, deduplicate, or identify records by display name. identity_class separates roster records from other-role records; repeated source occurrences are retained under source_records.

included: All fixed WRESTLERS records, including other-promotion records and records marked isManager.
All fixed, scheduled FA_ARRIVALS wrestler identities.
Structured ANN_STARTERS and ANN_ARRIVALS records as a separate announcer role class.
Static company and moonlight-loan-eligibility affiliations, initial seeded manager links, and explicit code-supported display-name variants.
Runtime identity-generation rules and the finite ECW discovery candidate-name list, without fabricating campaign instances or IDs.
excluded: Save files, campaign-specific runtime state, CAW formulas, game logs, match/tournament data, non-identity gameplay statistics, and unrelated source code.
Unkeyed narrative-only names such as company-owner labels and commentary fallback announcer strings; these are not stable roster records.

sources.kind: explicit conditional display-name changes; IDs remain unchanged

unkeyed_role_name_pools.note: These are plain string options selected into campaign state; no stable person ID is assigned by this source.

generated_identity_sources.configurable: newGame opts.indyPool changes the unsigned opening pool; names/attributes depend on the campaign RNG.
generated_identity_sources.limitation: The seed, opts.indyPool, game turn, and RNG determine actual IDs and names; no campaign was run.

generated_identity_sources.trigger: January week 4 in 1996–2001 when generatedTalentMode is not historical.
Turn divisible by 8, when ECW is the player promotion and its non-manager roster has fewer than 20 records.
generated_identity_sources.name_selection: One candidate is selected by the campaign RNG; a name may recur in another generated record.

generated_identity_sources.identity_class: generated development prospect; becomes a wrestler record on call-up
generated_identity_sources.intake_rule: Monthly chance 0.55 while a development territory exists and has fewer than 6 prospects.
generated_identity_sources.limitation: Prospects live in campaign state until called up; actual IDs/names require that state and RNG.

generated_identity_sources.name_source: User input or imported formula; the formula contains a name but no persistent external ID.
generated_identity_sources.limitation: CAW contents and campaign-local IDs are unavailable without campaign/save data.

data_quality.external_source_identifier_field: None found; id is the source code’s internal ID.
data_quality.note: Gender is exported only when the source record explicitly provides it; null/blank means unspecified, not male.

coverage_limits: Static data is not a complete real-world historical wrestler database. It covers the records explicitly represented by the audited source collections.
No game campaign was run and no save file or CAW formula was examined. Actual generated, custom, retired, or repackaged campaign records are not present as instance rows.
WRESTLERS.company is the source starting company. MOONLIGHT_SEED is loan-eligibility metadata, not a complete career-history or current-employer ledger.
Static roster records do not contain a comprehensive active/inactive/retired flag. Runtime employment and retirement status are campaign state.

The code can rename existing IDs (Madusa, Mankind, Scott Hall, Kevin Nash); arbitrary repackage names can be user-entered and are not preserved as structured alias history. Only explicit source-supported variants are included.

ANN_STARTERS and ANN_ARRIVALS are included as a separate structured announcer class. Other names stored only as company-owner, commentary, or narrative strings have no stable roster ID and are not emitted as identity records.
